The one place where the contract could leak a value is the floor: the document therefore fixes that the floor is a property of the request context and of the answer, that it is never an enumeration and never a default, and that no example value is presented as a value in force.

The offer body is the working read of ASM-B-S2-01-E3002-1: offerAmount, haircutAmount, validityDate, rangeLow, rangeHigh, floor and deviationFlag, with belowFloor on the answer. The range and the floor arrive as facts on the route decision signal from rwb-case, and no range, floor or validity column is created in rwb_treatment. The S1 owner of FEAT-VAL-06 confirms the names at the wave 2 contract freeze.

The release of a treatment rides POST /treatments/{treatmentId}/offer; this contract declares no release path of its own. A redelivered release is deduped by cloud event id in the inbox and by the Idempotency-Key on the offer operation. The OfferRelease body and the EV-10 body are the working read of ASM-B2-S2-002-4 and are published by RWB-S2-E3007-CON.
